_comment: Mutation testing for the context activity upload (docs/architecture/context-activity.md): reading a row's date and amount (Excel serials, day- or month-first, clock and worded durations), the deterministic best guess of the mapping (the Clockify and audit-log recognisers, the context column chosen by the values that name sub-units) and the optional model refinement, the mapping check, reading rows, placing rows on the unit itself or any unit below it and matching people to accounts and persons, the four comparison groups and the per-child table, the period read, the three-step service and its routes. WHY THESE FILES: every failure here is silent -- a date read the wrong way round moves a month of hours to another month, a context matcher one step too eager books a customer's hours on another customer, a replace window one day off double-counts a re-uploaded export, and a group test inverted turns the members of a team into 'active, not a member' suggestions for the member review. Scoped like the sibling API configs: these files plus their own unit tests, which are self-contained (temp folders from os.tmpdir(), no repository paths outside the sandbox, no PostgreSQL). MUTATOR SET: StringLiteral and ObjectLiteral disabled, matching the sibling configs -- so the SQL in store.js is not mutated and stays the contract test's job (contract-tests/contextActivity.contract.test.js). Run: cd app/api && npm run test:mutation:contextactivity NOT YET MEASURED: this config ships with the feature; break is deliberately absent until a first run measures a score.
